_about: One real source per category in the original set, all DISABLED; further news and trade sources were added later, also all DISABLED with review_required. Robots notes were checked by hand on the date each one records (2026-09-22 for the original six, 2026-10-10 for those added later); terms must be re-verified by a person before a source is enabled (PATCH enabled: true). Seeding never overwrites or enables an existing source.

sources.name: NASA news releases
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-09-22: User-agent * Allow /. The fetcher re-checks it on every run.
sources.terms_note: NASA's media usage guidelines say NASA material is generally not subject to copyright in the US; logos, insignia and third-party material are excluded. Store titles, links and short summaries; link back. Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: US federal government work in general; per-item credits may restrict reuse.

sources.name: Node.js blog
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-09-22: only /dist/ and /docs/ are disallowed; the feed path is allowed.
sources.terms_note: Content of the OpenJS Foundation and contributors; read the site's terms before enabling. Titles, links and short summaries only.

sources.name: Steam user review signals: Portal 2 (app 620)
sources.terms_note: Documented store endpoint (partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/getreviews); Steam's terms apply. Review text belongs to its authors and is deliberately not mapped: signals only (recommendation, votes, playtime, dates). Verify terms before enabling.

sources.name: DealNews daily deals
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-09-22: Crawl-delay 2 (honoured); the feed URL is not disallowed.
sources.terms_note: Copyright DealNews, all rights reserved (feed <copyright>). Headlines, prices exactly as stated and links only; a price is an observation at retrieval time, never a current price. Verify terms before enabling.

sources.name: Coupon codes published by merchants, entered by staff
sources.terms_note: Only codes a merchant published itself, entered with the URL of that page as evidence. Validity and expiry stay unknown unless the merchant states them; no code is 'working' because it was entered.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR: latest XBRL filings
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-09-22: /Archives/edgar is allowed; /cgi-bin is disallowed, so the EDGAR 'getcurrent' Atom feed is deliberately not used.
sources.terms_note: Public EDGAR data. SEC fair-access policy: a User-Agent that names the requester and a contact (ours does) and at most 10 requests per second. Informational context only — no advice, no execution.

sources.name: GOV.UK news and announcements
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-10: User-agent * disallows /*/print$ and /search/all*; the .atom feed at /search/news-and-communications.atom matches neither, so it is allowed. No crawl-delay for *.
sources.terms_note: Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/): copy, publish, distribute and exploit commercially, with acknowledgement and, where possible, a link to the licence. Credit the provider's attribution statement where given, otherwise the fallback 'Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.' No implied official status or endorsement. Store titles, links and short summaries only; never full text or images; drop items marked 'except where otherwise stated' (third-party rights, logos, personal data). Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/).

sources.name: European Commission press corner
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-10: User-agent * lists many disallowed paths but none for /commission/presscorner/ or its /api/; the feed path is allowed. No crawl-delay.
sources.terms_note: Content owned by the EU is licensed under CC BY 4.0: reuse allowed with appropriate credit and an indication of changes; per-item notices ('unless otherwise indicated') override. Credit 'European Commission' and link the licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). EU logos and names are excluded from the reuse policy. Store titles, links and short summaries only; never full text or images; drop third-party-credited items. Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. EU logos excluded.

sources.name: NOAA news
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-10: https://www.noaa.gov/robots.txt answers 403 to our identifying User-Agent (NOAA's CDN blocks bot UAs on HTML paths), so its rules could not be read; the FEED https://www.noaa.gov/rss.xml itself answers 200/application/rss+xml to our identifying UA. Resolve the robots/User-Agent 403 with NOAA before enabling.
sources.terms_note: Most NOAA information is in the US public domain and may be used with credit; third-party-credited items, images and video are excluded, and use must not imply US-Government endorsement or affiliation. Credit 'NOAA' (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) and link back. Store titles, links and short summaries only; never full text or images. Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: US federal government work (public domain) with per-item credits; credit NOAA.

sources.name: Frankfurter euro reference rates
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-10: https://frankfurter.dev/robots.txt and https://api.frankfurter.dev/robots.txt both say User-agent * Allow /; the /v2/rates path is allowed. No crawl-delay.
sources.terms_note: Frankfurter is MIT-licensed software, free for commercial use, with no API key and no quota (only anti-abuse rate limiting). The rates themselves fall under each provider's terms, so attribute the contributing provider (ECB, TCMB, ...) and link https://frankfurter.dev/ and the provider's terms; for ECB-sourced rates cite 'European Central Bank'. The legacy object endpoint https://api.frankfurter.app/latest cannot be mapped by the api adapter (it requires an array at items_path), so the array endpoint https://api.frankfurter.dev/v2/rates is used and each row (date, base, quote, rate) becomes one item. Rates are informational observations only, never advice (ADR-025). Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: Frankfurter software: MIT. Underlying rates: per provider (ECB reference rates reusable with attribution); see https://frankfurter.dev/license/.

sources.name: ECB euro reference rates: US dollar
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-10-10: User-agent * with Crawl-delay 5 (honoured; min_interval_ms is well above it) and disallows only *_content.<lang>.html and a few video/data paths; the /rss/fxref-usd.html feed path is not disallowed.
sources.terms_note: ECB statistics may be used freely and must be reproduced accurately with the ECB cited as the source; where incorporated into a sold product, buyers must be told the information is available free of charge from the ECB website. Cite 'European Central Bank' and link https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/disclaimer/html/index.en.html; no framing or logos. Store published rates as retrieved observations only — informational, never advice (ADR-025). Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: ECB copyright and disclaimer: free use with citation; see https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/disclaimer/html/index.en.html.
